class.name: VCSVParseOptions
class.brief_description:
Parser configuration (delimiter, quoting, comments, strictness, BOM...).
解析器配置（分隔符、引号、注释、严格性、BOM 等）。
class.description:
Pure data carrier passed to [VCSVParser]. [code]null[/code] options default to comma delimiter, double-quote quoting, headers enabled, trimming on and lenient row widths.
传给 [VCSVParser] 的纯数据载体。[code]null[/code] options 默认逗号分隔、双引号引号、启用表头、开启修剪、宽松行宽。

members.member:
Field separator (single character; also works as a DSV delimiter, e.g. tab or semicolon).
字段分隔符（单字符；也可作为 DSV 分隔符，如制表符或分号）。

Lines whose first field starts with this character are skipped.
首个字段以该字符开头的行会被跳过。

Trim leading/trailing whitespace of unquoted fields only.
仅修剪未加引号字段的首尾空白。

[code]true[/code] = a row with a different field count than the first row is a hard error; [code]false[/code] = pad/truncate with a warning.
[code]true[/code] = 行宽与首行不一致即硬错误；[code]false[/code] = 补齐/截断并警告。

Skip completely empty records.
跳过完全空白的记录。

Strip a leading UTF-8 byte order mark.
剥离开头的 UTF-8 字节序标记。

Whether the first data row is a header row (stored separately by [VCSVTable]).
首行是否为表头行（由 [VCSVTable] 单独存储）。

Header-name lookups ignore case (used by typed binding).
表头名查找忽略大小写（用于类型化绑定）。

Reserved; parse stops on the first hard error today.
预留；当前解析在首个硬错误即停止。

When non-empty, header cells of the form [code]name<sep>Type[/code] (e.g. [code]hp:int[/code]) are split: the annotation is stripped from the header name and the declared type is exposed via [member VCSVParseResult.column_types] and used by [method VCSVUtil.load_csv_dict_array]. Default empty (off) so plain headers containing the separator are never mangled.
非空时，形如 [code]名称<分隔符>类型[/code]（如 [code]hp:int[/code]）的表头会被拆分：注解从表头名剥离，声明的类型经 [member VCSVParseResult.column_types] 暴露，并被 [method VCSVUtil.load_csv_dict_array] 使用。默认空（关闭），避免含分隔符的普通表头被误改。

File encoding for [method VCSVParser.parse_file]: [code]utf8[/code] (default), [code]gbk[/code] or [code]gb2312[/code]. GBK/GB2312 decode covers the GB2312 core + common GBK characters (lead byte 0xA1-0xF7); unknown bytes become U+FFFD.
供 [method VCSVParser.parse_file] 使用的文件编码：[code]utf8[/code]（默认）、[code]gbk[/code] 或 [code]gb2312[/code]。GBK/GB2312 解码覆盖 GB2312 核心 + 常见 GBK 字符（首字节 0xA1-0xF7）；未知字节变为 U+FFFD。
